data: Microsoft's operating income rose from $88,523 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023) to $128,528 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended June 30, 2025). That is an increase of $40,005 million, or about 45.2% over the two years. For context, fiscal 2024 operating income was $109,433 million, so the growth came from gains of roughly 23.6% in fiscal 2024 and 17.4% in fiscal 2025.
